description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule, which models an XHTML 1.1 module with properties for elements, tags, attributes, and related transformations used in HTML purification. It includes methods for adding elements, creating blank elements, registering elements to content sets, parsing content models, merging attribute includes, and generating lookup tables.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule
classes.description: A class representing an XHTML 1.1 module with properties for elements, tags, attributes, and transformation rules used in HTML purification.

methods.name: getChildDef
methods.description: Returns false; intended to retrieve a child definition subclass based on element definitions.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Sets up a new element with specified content model, attributes, and content set registration.

methods.name: addBlankElement
methods.description: Creates a new, non-standalone, blank element definition.

methods.name: addElementToContentSet
methods.description: Registers an element to a specified content set.

methods.name: parseContents
methods.description: Transforms a string describing content model into a type and model array.

methods.name: mergeInAttrIncludes
methods.description: Merges attribute includes into an attribute array.

methods.name: makeLookup
methods.description: Creates a lookup table from a list of values with boolean true as values.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Placeholder for lazy loading setup, currently does nothing.
